lede: The biggest thing on the calendar this week is Ouray's joint work session Monday, where county commissioners and city council will sit down together to hash out a proposed intergovernmental agreement that would hand all city law enforcement over to the county sheriff starting January 1 — public comment is on the agenda at 5:00 PM. Closer to home, Telluride Town Council meets Tuesday with a public hearing on a development vesting extension and a work session on automated license plate reader cameras, while San Miguel County's BOCC and Planning Commission both take up affordable housing policy in separate sessions Wednesday and Thursday.
